 11960: function parseStudentLine(line) {
 11961:   const trimmed = String(line || "").trim();
 11962:   if (!trimmed) return { number: "", name: "" };
 11963:   const parts = trimmed.includes("\t")
 11964:     ? trimmed.split(/\t+/)
 11965:     : trimmed.includes(",")
 11966:       ? trimmed.split(/,+/)
 11967:       : trimmed.split(/\s+/);
 11968:   return { number: (parts.shift() || "").trim(), name: parts.join(" ").trim() };
 11969: }

  3092: async function inputCenterRunAutoOCR(drafts){

 11960: function parseStudentLine(line) {
 11961:   const trimmed = String(line || "").trim();
 11962:   if (!trimmed) return { number: "", name: "" };
 11963:   const parts = trimmed.includes("\t")
 11964:     ? trimmed.split(/\t+/)
 11965:     : trimmed.includes(",")
 11966:       ? trimmed.split(/,+/)
 11967:       : trimmed.split(/\s+/);
 11968:   return { number: (parts.shift() || "").trim(), name: parts.join(" ").trim() };
 11969: }

 11960: function parseStudentLine(line) {
 11961:   const trimmed = String(line || "").trim();
 11962:   if (!trimmed) return { number: "", name: "" };
 11963:   const parts = trimmed.includes("\t")
 11964:     ? trimmed.split(/\t+/)
 11965:     : trimmed.includes(",")
 11966:       ? trimmed.split(/,+/)
 11967:       : trimmed.split(/\s+/);
 11968:   return { number: (parts.shift() || "").trim(), name: parts.join(" ").trim() };
 11969: }

 11960: function parseStudentLine(line) {
 11961:   const trimmed = String(line || "").trim();
 11962:   if (!trimmed) return { number: "", name: "" };
 11963:   const parts = trimmed.includes("\t")
 11964:     ? trimmed.split(/\t+/)
 11965:     : trimmed.includes(",")
 11966:       ? trimmed.split(/,+/)
 11967:       : trimmed.split(/\s+/);
 11968:   return { number: (parts.shift() || "").trim(), name: parts.join(" ").trim() };
 11969: }

 11960: function parseStudentLine(line) {
 11961:   const trimmed = String(line || "").trim();
 11962:   if (!trimmed) return { number: "", name: "" };
 11963:   const parts = trimmed.includes("\t")
 11964:     ? trimmed.split(/\t+/)
 11965:     : trimmed.includes(",")
 11966:       ? trimmed.split(/,+/)
 11967:       : trimmed.split(/\s+/);
 11968:   return { number: (parts.shift() || "").trim(), name: parts.join(" ").trim() };
 11969: }

  3092: async function inputCenterRunAutoOCR(drafts){
  3093:   const targets=[];for(const d of drafts){d.ocrStatus='OCR처리중';d.ocrError='';const pages=Array.isArray(d.pages)&&d.pages.length?d.pages:[{filePath:d.filePath}];pages.forEach((p,i)=>{if(p.filePath)targets.push({key:`${d.draftId}::${i}`,path:p.filePath});});}
  3094:   render('inputs');if(!targets.length)return;
  3095:   const result=await window.schoolBoard?.runInputOCR?.({files:targets});if(!result?.ok){drafts.forEach(d=>{d.ocrStatus='OCR오류';d.ocrError=result?.reason||'로컬 OCR 호출 실패';});render('inputs');return;}
  3096:   const byKey=new Map((result.results||[]).map(x=>[x.key,x]));
  3097:   for(const d of drafts){const pages=Array.isArray(d.pages)&&d.pages.length?d.pages:[{filePath:d.filePath}];const texts=[],engines=new Set(),errors=[];pages.forEach((p,i)=>{const r=byKey.get(`${d.draftId}::${i}`);if(!r)return;if(r.ok&&r.text)texts.push(`[${i+1}페이지]\n${r.text}`);if(r.engine)engines.add(r.engine);if(!r.ok)errors.push(`${i+1}p ${r.reason||r.status||'OCR 실패'}`);});d.text=texts.join('\n\n').trim();d.rawText=d.text;d.ocrEngine=[...engines].join(' + ');d.ocrError=errors.join(' / ');d.ocrStatus=errors.length?(d.text?'OCR확인필요':'OCR오류'):(d.text?'OCR완료':'OCR확인필요');inputCenterApplyOcrMatch(d);}
  3098:   render('inputs');toast(`로컬 OCR 완료 · 자동매칭 ${drafts.filter(x=>x.studentNo).length}건 · 확인필요 ${drafts.filter(x=>!x.studentNo||/오류|확인필요/.test(String(x.ocrStatus||''))).length}건`);

  3234: function submissionDateText(value){
  3235:   const raw=String(value??"").trim();
  3236:   if(!raw)return "-";
  3237:   const serial=Number(raw);
  3238:   let date=null;
  3239:   if(Number.isFinite(serial)&&serial>20000&&serial<100000)date=new Date(Date.UTC(1899,11,30)+serial*86400000);
  3240:   else{
  3241:     const parsed=Date.parse(raw.replace(/오전/g,"AM").replace(/오후/g,"PM"));
  3242:     if(Number.isFinite(parsed))date=new Date(parsed);
  3243:   }
  3244:   if(!date||Number.isNaN(date.getTime()))return raw;
  3245:   return `${date.getFullYear()}.${String(date.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,"0")}.${String(date.getDate()).padStart(2,"0")}`;
  3246: }
